inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: The two definition blocks (book 232): Efficacy (maximal effect a drug can produce — intrinsic activity; represented by the y-value (Emax); ↑ y-value = ↑ Emax = ↑ efficacy; unrelated to potency — efficacious drugs can have high or low potency; partial agonists have less efficacy than full agonists) and Potency (amount of drug needed for a given effect; represented by the x-value (EC50); left shifting = ↓ EC50 = ↑ potency = ↓ drug needed; unrelated to efficacy — potent drugs can have high or low efficacy)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: PURE TEXT (pdfimages: zero raster images): the page's entire text content is the two symmetric definition blocks, each carrying its own axis assignment (y-value Emax vs x-value EC50), its own conversion chain, its own independence clause, and — for efficacy only — the partial-agonist clause; the ↑/↓ arrows carry \x8f/\x90 control bytes in the raw text layer (stripped by norm).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (DoseResponseMap in visuals/pharm-p6.tsx — Panel 1's rule chip '↑ y-value = ↑ Emax = ↑ efficacy' and partial-agonist note chip; Panel 2's rule chip 'left shifting = ↓ EC50 = ↑ potency = ↓ drug needed' and the 'EC = Effective concentration' note chip; Panel 4's four rule cards) + blocks[1] the table block carried verbatim in the note

inventory.visualPurpose: The two vector dose-response figures (book 232): RELATIVE EFFICACY (% Maximal effect 0-100 vs Log (drug dose); Drug A plateauing at Emax 100 and Drug B at Emax 50 at the same log-dose position; the Δ Efficacy bracket spanning the two plateaus) and RELATIVE POTENCY (Drug A left-shifted of Drug B with BOTH reaching the same maximal effect; two EC50 markers on the Log (drug dose) axis; the Δ Potency bracket spanning them; the 'EC = Effective concentration' note)
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: VECTOR LINE ART (pdfimages: zero rasters; text-layer census — the VLM confirm attempt failed 401 on environment credentials, so the topology stands on the raster count + the pre-extracted text layer and the task's pre-verified reading): two sigmoid-panel figures whose labels stream nearly cleanly — '% Maximal effect' and 'Log (drug dose)' axes on both, ticks 100 / 50 / 0, 'Emax Drug A' / 'Emax Drug B' with the 'Δ Efficacy' bracket label interleaved between them (raw 22-25), 'Drug A' / 'Drug B' with the 'Δ Potency' bracket label (raw 44-48) and the two-line 'EC = Effective / concentration' wrap straddled by the two EC50 labels (raw 50-54).
inventory.kypLocation: Panels 1-2 of the registry visual (DoseResponseMap in visuals/pharm-p6.tsx — the sigmoids recomputed from the logistic equation on original KYP axes: RELATIVE EFFICACY with Drug A's plateau at 100 and Drug B's at 50 and the vertical Δ Efficacy bracket; RELATIVE POTENCY with Drug A left-shifted at the same 100% ceiling, the two dashed EC50 markers, the horizontal Δ Potency bracket, and the left-shift arrow)
